description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe looking down and smiling while  leaning against the open driver's door of a black convertible automobile with one foot on the running board and one foot on the ground; she wears a black head scarf, long skirt, a white short sleeve scooped neck blouse under a dark sweater with a vest;  man in a dark suit sits in the passenger seat and  a young man in a white shirt sits in the jump-seat in the rear of the car.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
